snippet.title: Pettson's Inventions 4 - Trailer
snippet.description:
In the fourth game about Pettson’s Inventions we will explore the workshop together with Findus! Pettson is inside trying to figure out how to make his machine work. He has tried everything but he can’t make it to work. Of course, Findus wants to try and help Pettson with his machine, but to be able to do that he needs your help! Try to find muckles that have hidden all around the workshop, and solve the invention the muckle needs help with, to slowly but surely get closer to a solution for the machine.

Drag and drop the items onto the unfinished invention and try to put them in the right place. Press the lever and see what happens! Follow Findus instructions and try to solve all the tricky inventions! 

The simple interface combined with an adjustable degree of difficulty makes this game appealing for both kids and parents. In addition to that we have also made it even more fun searching for all the inventions!

- 50 brand new, tricky inventions
- Search the workshop for more mucklas together with Findus
- Voices in English, German and Swedish
- Original artwork from the creator of Pettson, Sven Nordqvist
- Kid friendly interface
- No in-app purchase
- No ads
- Choose to play with or without fake objects to adjust the difficulty level

Check out Pettson’s Inventions 1, 2 & 3 or the Deluxe edition for even more amazing and tricky inventions to complete.
